headword: {海洋生物|かいようせいぶつ}

definitions.explanation: Any living organism that inhabits the ocean, from microscopic plankton to whales.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧ (ocean) and ⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧ (living organism). Used in scientific, educational, and environmental contexts. The term covers all ocean life including fish, mammals, invertebrates, plants, and microorganisms.
